calibration.parameter_assignment: Complete native kernel count-weighted means grouped by full tensor ABI, using only three retained 4K captures. No Body measurement sets a parameter.
calibration.context_scope: These eight local kernels have no KV-context operand; context identifies assignment and validation captures, not a rule selector.
calibration.source_model_scope: Eight-layer BF16/W8A8 MoE declarations with the three retained E/K/sequence domains and explicit MC2 unfused caller.
calibration.parameter_grouping: Router casts, weight-scale casts, allocated SwiGLU/quant and expert adds share rules whenever their necessary physical ABI is identical. Matrix rules retain valid group histograms and storage capacity.
calibration.group_list_values: Source-derived force-EPLB active-prefix counts, not recorded tensor values.
calibration.validation_boundary: Whole-capture native kernel means and Body means; individual call jitter is separately retained.
